answer_1.quote: We conduct instruction-tuning on the synthesized data to evaluate its utility. As shown in Table , our data significantly improves long-context QA capabilities across various LLMs, with an average gain of at least 7.54%.
answer_1.outputs: The paper generates multi-hop question-answer pairs and instruction-tuning data for long-context scenarios, including code-related QA pairs.

answer_2.quote: As shown in Figure  (b), our method significantly improves data quality, yielding over 85% multi-hop, high-quality, and non-duplicative samples.

answer_3.quote: Motivated by these findings, we prompt LLMs to automatically generate quality scores for scalable and effective long-context data quality verification.

answer_4.quote: Participants are recruited from universities across China, and all must have passed the CET-6 exam or achieved an IELTS score of 6 or higher.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators are required to judge whether each sample is precise and reliable, minimizing errors or inconsistencies, and assess multi-hop, diversity, and high-quality properties.
